findings.location: source.html — paragraph where Ellie asks Grandpa (text: “Do you think you could lead the song ‘Saviour, Like A Shepherd Lead Us’ this next Sunday? I would really like to sing it again!”)
findings.source_quote: “Do you think you could lead the song ‘Saviour, Like A Shepherd Lead Us’ this next Sunday? I would really like to sing it again!”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the quoted English song title into Hindi and keep it consistently translated everywhere it appears. Example: replace the English title with a natural Hindi rendering such as “‘उद्धारकर्ता, चरवाहे की तरह हमें ले चलो’” (or “‘उद्धारकर्ता, चरवाहे की तरह हमें मार्गदर्शन करना’”), preserving the quotation marks and surrounding punctuation. Do not leave the song title in English inside the quoted sentence. The rest of the sentence should remain as already translated.
findings.translation_quote: “क्या आप अगली रविवार वो गीत ‘Saviour, Like A Shepherd Lead Us’ गा सकते हैं? मैं उसे फिर से गाना चाहती हूँ!”
